evidence_quote: When implementing ISO 50001, it is of vital importance that Top Management gives their full commitment to its implementation which includes technical, financial and human resources.
One of the main challenges faced during the Semen Tonasa implementation was the balancing act the energy team had to play between implementing ISO 50001 and their other primary duties/roles.
Increasing the competence of human resources / energy teams through training is very necessary to support the implementation of energy management.
It is important to build an IT system and central data base so that energy performance can be monitored online and all records are well documented.
